roster.name: Announced
roster.note: India commits to flying its own astronauts on its own rocket — the goal that would make it the fourth nation with independent human spaceflight

roster.name: Test Vehicle abort
roster.note: the first flight test demonstrates the crew-escape system, which must pull the capsule clear of a failing rocket — the safety capability a crewed program is built around

roster.name: First crewed flight
roster.note: the planned debut of an Indian crew in an Indian spacecraft — targeted for the mid-2020s, joining Russia, the US and China as independent human spaceflight powers
